title: LiveAnomaly
description: A deterministically detected, sustained deviation of a live intraday signal from the day's expected level. Schema-compatible with the existing Anomaly (anomaly.schema.json) — this contract documents the live-specific value space (new codes/themes) and the detection provenance fields.

code.description: Anomaly code. Live detection uses the reused/added values below.

theme.description: Grouping theme. Live detection uses recovery (HRV), stress (HR), and the new vitals theme (SpO2, skin temp, respiration).

severity.description: Mapped from abs(percentage_change) against the existing ANOMALY_*_PCT / CRITICAL_THRESHOLD_PCT tiers.

signals.description: Live signal key(s) that triggered the anomaly.

evaluation_tag.description: Deterministic label derived from the sign of the deviation and its severity tier.

detail.description: Human-readable provenance, e.g. 'spo2 8.2% below day's expected level (live 30-min trend)'.
